title: Koolute bu njëkk biñ yàq ci Aljanna
intro: Xalaatal sudoon danga taxaw ci jardin bu bari jàmm, jardin bu gëna sargal mbindéef yépp, te benn pegg kese lañu wara sargal. Wax ju woyof dafay dige ba fàww, benn tànneef mooy soppi lépp, waaye yërmaande ubbi na yoonu dellu. Kan moo wax ci ndoorte nit?
clues: Yàlla moo ma sàkk ci ban, defar ma ci xel mu dal.
Teraloon naa ba Yàlla digël malaaka yi ñu sujjóot ci man.
Maa ngi dëkk ci Aljanna ak sama jabar, te mënoon nañu lekk lépp ludul benn garab.
Seytaane bi ma waat ni dina nekk ab digalkat bu dëggu moo ma nax.
Ma lekk ci garab giñ ma tere, ba noppi ma dindi sama mbubb ndax rus ci sama bopp.
Jàngoon naa ay kàdduy tuub ci sama Boroom, Yàlla jublu ci man ci yërmaande.

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
